If you're seeing this, then, PTZ Extension got an error when trying to access the camera. This probably means that the Extension doesn't have permission to the camera.

You can fix this by going to the Site Settings for this extension and going to the "Permissions" section and then changing the drop down for Camera to "Ask".

Then go to Options and follow the instructions there.
